[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. "What AI reveals about humans" by Shyam Sankar: Discusses how AI can help understand human behavior and decision-making.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. "The AI that learns like a child" by Josh Tenenbaum: Talks about AI learning and reasoning like humans.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. "How AI can enhance our humanity" by Fei-Fei Li: Discusses how AI can augment human capabilities.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. "The dark side of AI" by Zeynep Tufekci: Discusses potential risks and consequences of AI, including bias and surveillance.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. "The AI that beats humans at games" by Demis Hassabis: Discusses the development of AlphaGo.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 10. "The future of work: Robots, AI and automation" by Andrew Ng: Discusses the impact of AI and automation on the job market.
